main_text.l: קנה Ch. & Syr. Comparare, emere, acqui-
rere, acquisitum possidere, Ethpeh. Particip.
Acquiritur, Act. 8.20.
קנינא, קניא Ch. Syr. Emptio, acquisitio, posses-
sio: substantia, opes, facultates, divitiæ. Pl. קנינין.
קנה, קנא, קני Chald. & Syr. Canna, calamus, culmus,
arundo, calamus odoratus, aromaticus, calamus
mensorius. Plur. קני, קנין.
קנאה, קינאה, קינאָרה Ch. Faber, conflator, aurifaber, ar-
gentarius: Syr. Faber ærarius, χαλκεύς, 2.
ad Tim. 4.14.
Plur. קינאי, קינאין Esth. 5.14.
קנינא Talmud. Venatores, Ex Græco κυνηγέω.
Venor: Κυνηγός, Venator. Legitur & Esth. 1.2. in Tar.
sec. sub finem illius versus, sed alio sensu. Elias ex-
plicat בעליצחוק. Videtur sumi pro Artificibus, O-
pificibus.
קנד Syr. Periculum, pericula, Re-
spondet Græco κίνδυνω in sing. & plur. κινδύνοις,
Syr. Candace, Insula Æthiopiæ, Act. 8.27.
קנט Ch. Irritare, incitare, concitare: quomodo co-
nvenit Græ. Κεντέω vel κνήθω: vel Affligere, ut sit idem
quod נקט per Metathesin litterarum: Nam Exo. 22.
20. in Jon. respondet Hebræo תונה, & Numer 21.5.
quod in Jon. dicitur נפשנא קנטת במנא, id in T.H. ex-
primitur per מעיקא. Deinde Syr. est Vitare, evitare,
Evitamus autem hoc, 2. ad
Corinth.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several Syriac and Hebrew forms are doubtful, notably the Syriac vowel-pointed words and the Hebrew in the Jonah citations. The Syriac lines at the start of entries 2 and 4 are reproduced approximately.
